dimensions.name: SPF & Broad Spectrum
dimensions.description: Is SPF level and broad spectrum/PA rating clearly stated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No SPF. 3: SPF number only. 5: SPF + 'broad spectrum'. 7: SPF + PA rating. 10: Full SPF + PA++++ + UVA/UVB protection explanation.

dimensions.name: Filter Type Transparency
dimensions.description: Is the filter type disclosed (mineral/physical, chemical, hybrid)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No filter info. 3: Vague. 5: 'Mineral' or 'chemical' stated. 7: Specific active ingredients (zinc oxide, titanium dioxide, avobenzone). 10: Full filter breakdown with percentage and protection mechanism.

dimensions.name: White Cast & Finish
dimensions.description: Is white cast addressed and finish type described (matte, dewy, natural)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 3: 'Lightweight'. 5: 'No white cast'. 7: White cast + finish type. 10: White cast addressed for all skin tones + finish type + photo evidence or testing.

dimensions.name: Under-Makeup Compatibility
dimensions.description: Is under-makeup performance and daily wear suitability communicated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 3: 'Daily wear'. 5: 'Works under makeup'. 7: Specific makeup compatibility details. 10: Full daily-wear positioning with no-pilling guarantee and primer-like benefits.

dimensions.name: Skin Type Targeting
dimensions.description: Is suitability for specific skin types/concerns addressed (oily, sensitive, acne-prone)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No targeting. 5: 'All skin types'. 10: Specific type suitability with oil-control or sensitive-skin formulation details.

dimensions.name: Environmental Claims
dimensions.description: Are reef-safe, ocean-friendly, or environmental impact claims made?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 5: 'Reef-safe'. 10: Reef-safe with specific excluded ingredients (oxybenzone, octinoxate) and certification.

dimensions.name: Clean Formulation
dimensions.description: Are fragrance-free, paraben-free, alcohol-free, non-comedogenic stated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 5: Some callouts. 10: Comprehensive clean formulation positioning.

dimensions.name: Application & Reapplication
dimensions.description: Are application amount and reapplication guidance provided?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No guidance. 5: Basic 'apply generously'. 10: Specific amount (2-finger rule), reapply every 2 hours, water-resistance duration.

dimensions.name: Clinical & Dermatologist Backing
dimensions.description: Is dermatologist-tested, clinically proven, or clinical study referenced?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 5: 'Dermatologist recommended'. 10: Specific clinical testing with protection verification.
